fillInstructions.description: Behind Scooby-Doo is the interior of the central rounded white panel: a clean, nearly uniform white fill with very subtle compression noise and no scene details. The removed area should be inpainted as flat panel white so the center remains blank.
continueEdges: Continue the panel’s uniform white interior seamlessly through the entire hole.
At the lower clipped contour where the character meets the panel boundary, keep the fill aligned with the same interior white up to that edge; do not introduce new outlines or shadows.
fillInstructions.texture: Mostly flat solid fill; extremely light JPEG grain/compression mottling only.
